They really know how to take care of a pomeranian coat since it’s so delicate and one wrong cut can stop the hair from growing back right. 10 out of 10 recommend. They also have really cute dog accessories and we got our baby the best dog bag ever

I know this review is a bit overdue—I probably should’ve written it after my second or third visit to Dluxe Dog Grooming. I’ve been bringing my pup here for about two years now, and the service is truly unmatched. I’ve tried several other places before, but nothing compares to how happy my dog is when we arrive—he actually pulls me toward the door! That says it all. Honestly, I don’t need to say much more—just give them a try and see for yourself!
They are amazing. I love them.
They always take such good care of my dog. This place takes their time to make sure your pet gets the care they deserve and always comes out looking great.
Great service n staff

I have been coming here for over 5 years now.  I trust Arnie and his team. They are kind and clean and it is a fun safe environment to leave my dog.  I am always pleased with the great job they do on my boy Harry Winston.  I moved to boca 2 years ago and drive an hour and half each way for this experience.   Best Groomer!!!!!❤️
Excellent service, very pleased with the result. They took into account every detail I asked for. Highly recommended.
D’Luxe has been the most caring and talented as well as thoughtful business to engage with in grooming our Lucca. Arnie and his team are genuine  and professional. They are a pleasure to work with.

I had such a positive experience with this groomer! The team was so patient and gentle with my anxious dog, and it made all the difference. You can really tell they love what they do and genuinely care about the dogs they work with. It’s rare to find a place where both you and your pup feel at ease—highly recommend!
Absolutely love this place! The personal touch, the work, the prices! We have tried many dog grooming places and this is our favorite !

What a fabulous experience always with Arnie! We’ve been bringing Ava here since she was 6 months & we’re always so happy with the service & her grooming. She always smell so good for days, highly recommend!

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Deluxe Dogs Pet Concierge & Boutique! I was traveling and recommended to this location by a friend in Miami, and I am so grateful for the suggestion. From start to finish, my experience was exceptional.

I brought my toy poodle, Bella, in for grooming, and they were able to accommodate us seamlessly. The grooming services were top-notch—Bella came out looking absolutely adorable, clean, and perfectly trimmed. While there, I decided to take advantage of their dental cleaning services, and the difference it made in Bella’s smile was incredible. She’s happier, healthier, and flashing her pearly whites more than ever!

Arnie and his team are truly a class act. They are kind, honest, and incredibly professional. You can tell they genuinely love and care for every single dog that comes through their doors. I felt completely at ease leaving Bella in their care, knowing she was in the best hands.

To top it all off, their boutique is a dream for any dog owner! I couldn’t resist purchasing a Gucci everyday dog carrier along with a matching leash and collar for Bella. The variety of high-quality clothing and accessories they offer is impressive—it’s a one-stop shop for everything your dog could ever need.

If you’re looking for unparalleled grooming, dental services, or luxurious dog accessories, Deluxe Dogs is the place to go. I highly recommend them to anyone who wants only the best for their furry companion!
By far the best. They love my JhonZ.  Caro.Ernie and the crue are pure love
best grooming ever
